record.dic_text:
2581 Kananites {kan-an-ee'-tace}

源自亞蘭文, 參 SNH07067; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Canaanite 2; 2

1) 原意為"熱心,狂熱",在新約用來稱呼耶穌的門徒西門,因為他以前可能隸屬"激進"或"自由戰士"黨派，
   因此和合本譯為"奮銳黨的" (#太 10:4; 可 3:18|)
record.edic_text:
2581 Kananites {kan-an-ee'-tace}

of Aramaic origin, cf 07067;; n pr m

AV - Canaanite 2; 2

Canaanite = "zealous"
1) the surname of apostle Simon, otherwise known as "Simon Zelotes"

same.cexp: 激進黨，和：奮銳黨〔熱誠者〕
